subject: PhytoTech onboarding: alignment, owners, sprint 0 checklist
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Elena Soto <elena@phytotech.io>, Marcus Reed <m.reed@phytotech.io>
Date: 2026-08-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PhytoTech onboarding: alignment, owners, sprint 0 checklist

Team — looping you all in for the formal sales→CS handoff for PhytoTech (deal RDW-2026-PT-389). Quick context up front:

- ARR: $430k ARR first-year; committed Dedicated capacity + Private deployment (VPC).
- Target go-live: 2026-08-31 (customer expects pilot traffic the week of Sep 6).
- Must-haves: VPC peering, dedicated GPU pool (NVIDIA H100), customer-side IP allowlist, audit logging retention 1 year.

What we have attached: SOW draft (v1), network requirements spreadsheet (they've flagged firewall questions), and a rough network diagram from their infra team.

Customer contacts (external):
- Elena Soto — Head of AI Ops (primary)
- Marcus Reed — Platform Lead (network/infra)

Immediate asks for CS/Implementation:
1) Triage security/prep: confirm what we need for a VPC/on-prem connectivity checklist and if a RedTeam review is required.
2) Owners: assign a primary implementation lead and technical reviewer.
3) Sprint 0 checklist: validation of acceptance criteria, staging plan, and any additional data access requests.
4) Kickoff: customer asked for a kickoff slot the week of Aug 10. Please propose 30–45 minute slots.

Notes: procurement is finalizing start-of-work once SOW comments are reconciled — expect some minor redlines around data retention. I've copied Elena and Marcus for transparency.

Attachments:
- PhytoTech_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW draft, highlights: dedicated nodes, 99.9% uptime target)
- phyto_network_requirements.xlsx (network questions flagged by Marcus)
- network_diagram.png (customer-provided)

Thanks — I can jump on the kickoff if useful.

— Priyom
Priyom Das | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415 555 0123
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-07T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PhytoTech onboarding: alignment, owners, sprint 0 checklist

Thanks, Priyom — received and helpful summary. Triage notes below and next steps: 

- Assigning myself as program owner for the initial run (will own kickoff, acceptance criteria, and A/B rollback policy).
- Karthik will own technical validation (staging, capacity sizing, quantization profile recommendations).
- Grace will coordinate the internal security intake and hit the SOC2 artifact list.

Proposed kickoff times (30–45m):
- Tue Aug 10, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed Aug 11, 09:30–10:15 PT
- Thu Aug 12, 14:00–14:45 PT

Action items for this thread (short):
- Karthik: review network spreadsheet and flag anything blocking before kickoff.
- Grace: pull SOC2 artifacts and put a short packet into the Drive link (see related_links).
- Priyom: please confirm which of the two SOW redlines are flexible (data retention vs. support hours).

Elena / Marcus — any preference on the kickoff slot? We can do a shorter 30m sync if you'd prefer.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Soto <elena@phytotech.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Reed <m.reed@phytotech.io>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-07T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PhytoTech onboarding: alignment, owners, sprint 0 checklist

Thanks, all — Wed Aug 11 09:30 PT works best for us. Quick note from Marcus: our security team needs clarification on the following before kickoff: 

- Do you support VPC peering with transit VPC (we have a hub-and-spoke design)?
- Are there any specific CIDR ranges you require for dedicated instances?
- For audit logs: can Redwood retain logs in our customer-managed bucket or do logs go to Redwood-managed storage only?

Also, small ask — can you include a short runbook for emergency rollback/fallback once you confirm the dedicated pool? Prefer 1–2 pages we can circulate to our on-call.

Elena
Elena Soto | Head of AI Ops | PhytoTech
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Elena Soto <elena@phytotech.io>, Marcus Reed <m.reed@phytotech.io>

Subject: Re: PhytoTech onboarding: alignment, owners, sprint 0 checklist

On Mon, Aug 7, 2026 at 09:12 AM Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — looping you all in for the formal sales→CS handoff for PhytoTech (deal RDW-2026-PT-389). Quick context up front:

Thanks — confirmed kickoff Wed Aug 11 09:30 PT. Following up with the technical prep plan and owner assignments (short):

- Implementation lead: Tessa Morgan (primary contact for scheduling + acceptance criteria).
- Technical lead: Karthik Iyer (staging, perf tuning, KV cache policies, quantization profile).
- Security lead: Grace O'Connor (SOC2 artifacts, security intake).
- Escalation contact (sales): Priyom Das.

Sprint 0 checklist (I'll own items marked TECH):
1) TECH — Review phyto_network_requirements.xlsx and flag any firewall/NAT restrictions. Deliverable: annotated sheet by Tue Aug 11 12:00 PT.
2) Confirm CIDR ranges & VPC peering approach (options: direct peering or transit via hub). Deliverable: recommendation + risk note.
3) Provide a 1–2 page rollback/runbook (we'll adapt our template). Deliverable: draft by Aug 13 COB.
4) Validate dedicated node sizing: initial estimate 4xH100 (burstable to 6) based on expected QPS — confirm by Aug 12.
5) Acceptance criteria doc: staging pass test list + latency targets (p95 < 250ms). Deliverable: Tessa to publish Aug 11 meeting notes.

Attachments included again when I send the annotated network sheet.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Staff ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
